name: Vercel for Startups Credits
free_limit: Up to $30,000 in a one-time Vercel flexible platform credit commitment over one year for approved partner-affiliated startups, covering eligible compute, data transfer, seats, AI Gateway, v0 and other Vercel services.
watch_out: Startup must be Series A or earlier, within 12 months of its latest funding, have a company website/email and proof of partner affiliation; previous startup-credit recipients are excluded. Actual award varies by partner. A valid payment method is mandatory. Only up to 50% of the commitment may be applied to AI Gateway and unused balance expires after one year; paid rates apply afterward.
